summary: No new ecosystem or asset crossed the framework's notification threshold since the 15:40 UTC scan. Existing STONK/Raydium, HYPE/Hyperliquid and PONS/Robinhood Chain leadership remains the relevant prior state. Sui is the clearest watch candidate because weekly DEX volume and stablecoin supply are accelerating, but attribution, wallet-quality and token-structure evidence are still insufficient for an alert. BNB Chain, Avalanche and several perp venues remain materially incentive- or concentration-contaminated.

stonk_solana.evidence: The independently funded STONK whale purchase reported earlier today was followed by a new ATH around $0.2234. This is forward validation of the already-alerted 10:20 UTC signal rather than a new rotation event. Broad Solana DEX volume is roughly flat-to-down week-on-week while stablecoin supply is up about 5%, so the prior Raydium/LaunchLab sub-ecosystem interpretation remains more precise than a blanket Solana regime call.

hype_hyperliquid.evidence: HYPE remains near $86.5-$86.7 and close to the recent high, while Hyperliquid stablecoin supply is up about 2.3% over seven days. However, spot DEX volume is down about 21% week-on-week and perps volume down about 12%, so there is no fresh velocity breakout beyond the prior capital-stock/OI thesis.

pons_robinhood_chain.evidence: Robinhood Chain still shows about $1.81B 24h DEX volume, +38.3% weekly DEX growth and +23.4% seven-day stablecoin growth. No new independently verified selective-wallet convergence or structurally cleaner challenger displaced PONS. Existing subsidy and concentration caveats remain relevant.

sui_deepbook.ecosystem_evidence: Sui DEX volume is about $50M/day with +44.9% weekly growth and stablecoin supply about $454M with +13.2% seven-day growth. DeepBook processes about $13.3M/day against $84.8M over seven days, with no reported protocol incentives and direct DEEP token-holder value capture via burns/vault economics.
sui_deepbook.why_not_alert: The current Sui daily DEX run-rate is only modestly above its trailing-week average, stablecoin-transfer activity is structurally gasless and therefore must be discounted as a discretionary-speculation signal, DEEP lacks verified selective-wallet convergence/holder-acceleration evidence, and a September 14 insider unlock remains an overhang.

sui_bluefin.evidence: Bluefin Spot volume is running above its seven-day daily average, but BLUE has no direct token-holder revenue, a market cap of only roughly $5.6M, and an upcoming September 11 unlock of about 24.2M BLUE equal to roughly 7.3% of market cap, primarily to private investors and insiders. Historical distribution also included points/airdrop programs.

bnb_chain.evidence: BNB Chain DEX volume remains up about 36.8% week-on-week, but stablecoin supply is down roughly 0.7% and the Four.meme BNC4 campaign explicitly rewards volume competition with buybacks, undermining clean discretionary-flow attribution.

avalanche.evidence: Avalanche DEX volume remains up about 73% week-on-week, but stablecoins are slightly down, net inflow is negative, and activity remains highly concentrated in Pharaoh, whose ve(3,3) emissions/gauge design introduces incentive contamination.

new_perp_venues.evidence: Several fast-growing perp venues outside Hyperliquid are explicitly running farming, points or rewards programs; headline volume acceleration is therefore discounted until organic post-incentive persistence appears.

methodology_notes: Existing signals are not re-alerted solely because they subsequently trade higher.
Sui stablecoin-transfer transaction counts are discounted because supported stablecoin transfers are protocol-level gasless at $0.00 fees.
A high opportunity score cannot override token unlock, concentration, incentive-attribution or executability concerns.
No paper trade or trade recommendation is created by this research-only scan.
